text:
sophie: Heads-up — noticed console charts jank on staging after last frontend canary. Sparklines are stuttering on scroll and initial paint LCP jumped ~800ms. Repro: open /app/dashboard with ~12 widgets and scroll.

ajay: confirmed on my laptop :eyes: staging build tag canary-2026-03-19-17, lots of dropped frames when charts mount.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary-2026-03-19-17 deployed to staging by kelly

sophie: bundle analyzer shows a +1.8MB bump between v2.3 -> v2.4. Biggest diff: telemetry-client and a new telemetry-sharedlib chunk. Suspect telemetry sampler change pulling in sync deps.

kelly: I bumped telemetry-client to v2.4 for sampler fixes. didn't expect the sharedlib to be synced in the dashboard entry chunk. @ajay can you check whether it's being imported at top-level?

ajay: digging now. telemetry-client's index imports 'perf-hooks' sync in index.ts which drags the sharedlib into main. quick patch is lazy import in onMount. Idea: wrap init in requestIdleCallback / import().

derek: fwiw, traces show KV cache prefix-miss spike at the same time — more telemetry calls during render might be thrashing cache lookups. worth correlating events.

maria: we should never have init side-effects during render. For rollouts/UX, analytics are valuable but can't regress FCP/LCP. Can we gate heavy telemetry behind a low-priority task queue or user-consent for non-critical metrics?

sophie: agreed. For a hotfix: revert telemetry-client to v2.3 on staging and patch v2.4 to lazy-load sampler. Can someone open an immediate canary rollback?

kelly: on it. Plan: 1) revert package.json to v2.3, 2) add import() wrapper around sampler init, 3) run yarn build --stats and smoke test with lighthouse. ETA ~30m.

ajay: short-term mitigation for prod: route-level code-splitting for /dashboard so charts land in their own chunk, and enable prefix KV caching for chart tile requests to avoid repeated fetches while scrolling.

ajay: quick repro commands I'm running:
```
yarn build --stats
npx source-map-explorer dist/main.*.js
```

deploy-bot: rollback: reverted telemetry-client to v2.3 in canary-2026-03-19-17-rollback by kelly

sophie: after rollback staging LCP back to baseline and sparklines smooth again. Creating follow-up: PERF-874 to analyze telemetry chunking, sampler side-effects, and chart caching policy (canary -> prod mitigation + long-term sampling redesign).

kelly: adding notes to the PR and tagging @platform for policy decision on telemetry-init patterns.

derek: assign me to PERF-874, will attach flamegraphs and KV cache heatmap.

sophie: thanks all. we'll keep the rollback in canary until we've validated patch and perf tests pass. :thumbsup:
